title: Coordination for interworking with ePDG connected to EPC

entities.name: PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to transfer PDN connections from ePDG to N1 mode during inter-system change

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: Message used to initiate PDU session establishment for transferring PDN connections to N1 mode

entities.name: PDU session identity
entities.description: Identity allocated by UE for PDN connection when establishing via ePDG, used later for PDU session transfer

entities.name: Request type
entities.description: Indicates whether the PDU session is for existing emergency session or existing regular session

entities.name: PDU session type
entities.description: Specifies the IP version support (IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6) based on previously allocated home address information

entities.name: DNN
entities.description: Data Network Name mapped from the APN of the PDN connection

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information provided by network and used for PDU session transfer

entities.name: Emergency PDN connection condition
entities.description: Condition indicating whether the PDN connection is for emergency bearer services

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI condition
entities.description: Condition requiring that associated S-NSSAI is included in allowed NSSAI for target access

entities.name: PDN connection transfer to N1 mode
entities.description: Property describing the transfer of PDN connections from ePDG to N1 mode during inter-system change

relations.description: PDU session establishment procedure involves sending PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message contains PDU session identity
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message contains request type
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message contains PDU session type
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message contains DNN
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message contains S-NSSAI
Emergency PDN connection condition determines the value of request type IE
Allowed NSSAI condition guards the PDN connection transfer to N1 mode
PDN connection transfer property is established through PDU session establishment procedure
